At the same release, CancelTaskParams contains only meta: Option<RequestMetaObject> and task_id: String; no stock generation/fence field exists.

RequestMetaObject is a transparent wrapper over MetaObject/JsonObject, preserves arbitrary extension keys, and dereferences to the underlying metadata map, so a namespaced custom generation/fence key is schema-compatible.

For incoming requests, the exact meta.rs contract says wire params._meta is stripped into request envelope extensions, typed params meta fields stay empty, and the service loop moves metadata into RequestContext.meta before dispatch. Therefore update/cancel validation must read the custom fence key from RequestContext.meta rather than request.meta.

Smallest source-qualified validation sketch: before any persistent task mutation, read a namespaced generation value from RequestContext.meta; parse it fail-closed as the chosen canonical integer/token type; obtain principal identity only from the previously-identified server-authenticated transport/context path rather than client _meta; load/claim the task by task_id; require stored owner principal equality and current generation equality; only then apply update/cancel under the persistent store's atomic generation CAS. Missing, malformed, owner-mismatched, or stale generation fails before mutation.
